disposition: CHANGES REQUIRED: canonical host Clear provenance is fixed, but winning local Clear does not reset prepainted underline.
positive_findings: The synthetic Warning/Accent calibration and same_underline_binding comparison are removed. Each text decoration target has one normal host resolution.

Final canonical underline Slot::Clear is retained as private PaintStyle metadata, with an additive accessor. Existing private fields already prevent external struct literals, so the added private field does not introduce a new mandatory public literal field.

Canonical accumulation, local Set/Clear override order, profile binding, raw underline setters, and unrelated modifier patches have focused tests. Existing ResolvedStyle.explicit semantics were not widened.

Grid update and draw use the same embedded-cell presentation. Shared geometry drives pointer mapping, scrolling, clipping, and cursor placement. Default TextInput configuration remains unchanged when embedded mode and target are absent.

Host decoration transfers underline color and UNDERLINED only; input foreground/background remain independently resolved. No exact-color or application/test-identity renderer was introduced in this bounded library series.

finding.problem: A local underline Slot::Clear correctly prevents the host underline override, but no Color::Reset is emitted for that winning local Clear. The resolved style has no underline color, so ordinary buffer patching leaves a prepainted underline intact.
finding.reproduction: Prepaint an underlined yellow cell, draw TextInput.embedded_cell().patch(&clear).text_style_target(GRID,DEFAULT,TEXT) with a host Accent underline. The actual text underline remains Yellow instead of Reset.
finding.fix: Carry the winning local canonical Clear into the actual text underline reset while retaining local Set, host Clear/Inherit/Set, semantic profile binding, and modifier precedence. Do not reintroduce calibration or infer authored channels from colors.

native.command: cargo nextest run --locked -p termrock-fields -p termrock-grid -p termrock-theme --all-targets --no-fail-fast

clippy.command: cargo clippy --locked -p termrock-fields -p termrock-grid -p termrock-theme --all-targets -- -D warnings

verification.formatting: Scoped rustfmt --edition2024 --check passed for the six changed library/test files. git diff --check passed; the source worktree remains clean.

limits: This verdict applies only to exact26e4. Concurrent external9268 downgrade changes are not included.
No full frozen CLI parity or complete architecture acceptance is established.
